name: Cloud-Native Systems Programmer
description: Build microservices, service meshes, and cloud-native infrastructure in C/C++. Implement gRPC services, load balancers, and circuit breakers.
example_snippet:
program LoadBalancer:
    shape Backend holds:
        Address as text
        Port as whole number
        Healthy as truth value
        ActiveConnections as whole number
    end shape

    action select_backend takes Backends as raw handle to Backend, Count as whole number produces text:
        repeat Count times using I:
            keep B as raw handle to Backend
            put transmute Backends as * raw handle to Backend into B
            keep Offset as whole number
            put the product of I and 32 into Offset
            keep Ptr as raw handle to Backend
            put transmute B as raw handle to byte and Offset into Ptr
            if Ptr.Healthy then:
                produce success with Ptr.Address
            end if
        end repeat
        produce success with "none"
    end action

    print the text "Load balancer initialized" and newline
end program
status_note: C++ backend active (C++17/20/23, CI-tested). HTTP/2 and TLS via dictum_tls.c + dictum_net.c. Cloud SDKs (AWS/GCP) require C imports.
